strings.subtitle: — Sesenyi sa difaele —
strings.no_file: Ga go faele yeo e kgethilwego
strings.dnd_unavailable: Go hula le go tlogela ga go hwetšagale. Šomiša konopo yeo e lego ka tlase.
strings.ft_lnk: Tsela ye kopana (.lnk) — e tla ganywa
strings.strategy_full: ☢  WO TLALETŠEGO — ka moka ka lefela (e bolokegilego)
strings.ssd_warning:
Temoso! Go SSD, mokgwa wa go ngwala godimo ga o netefatše go senyega ka ntlha ya TRIM.
Lenaneo le ke la HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Faele "{name}" e tla ngwalwa godimo gomme e phumolwe.

Tšwela pele?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.error_cannot_read:
Ga e kgone go bala faele:
{err}
strings.report_title: ✅  FAELE E NGWADILWE GODIMO GOM ME E PHUMOLWE
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS mela ya datha ye mengwe (ADS) ga e šome.
• Kuranta ya USN ga e hlwekiswe.
• Dikopi tša moriti le dikgokagano tša maru
  (OneDrive bj.bj.) ga di amege.
strings.status_full: Diteng ka moka di ngwadilwe godimo ka lefela. Go boa ga go kgonege — didirišwa di tla bona lefela fela.
strings.status_fast: Hlogo, moela le mela ya 4 MB di ngwadilwe godimo. Tše dingwe ga se tša amega, eupša ka ntlha ya dikgala, go boa ka moka ka didirišwa tša moreki ga go kgonege. Go ditokumente tša sephiri šomiša MOKGWA WO TLALETŠEGO.
strings.status_empty: Faele e be e le lefela, go ngwala godimo ga go a hlokege. E phumotšwe.
strings.error_permission: Ga e kgone go fihlelela faele. E ka ba e bulwe ka lenaneo le lengwe. E tswale gomme o leke gape.
strings.error_not_found: Faele ga se ya hwetšwa. E ka ba e phumotšwe.
strings.error_is_symlink: Ye ke kgokagano ya seswantšho. Dikgokagano ga di kgone go senyega — faele ya nepo e tla dula e lokile.
strings.error_reparse: Ye ke faele ya lefelo (OneDrive goba ye e swanago). Datha ya yona e marung, e sego ka disking — mo ga go na seo se ka senyegago.
strings.error_not_file: Ye ga se faele (foldara goba se sengwe). Tlogela faele.
strings.error_hardlinks: Faele ye e na le dikgokagano tše dingwe tše thata ({n} ka moka). Dikgokagano tše thata ga di na yo mogolo — maina ka moka a a lekana. Ge o ka senya ka tsela ya bjale, datha e tla ngwalwa godimo gomme e segwe go 32 byte, eupša masaledi a tla dula a fihlelega ka dikgokagano tše dingwe. Phumola dikgokagano ka moka pele.
strings.error_compressed:
Faele e gateletšwe, e khupilwe goba e sesa. Go ngwala godimo ka lefela ga go netefatše go senyega ga datha ya kgale ka gobane NTFS e e boloka ka tsela ye e fapanego.

Tloša tšhobokanyo: klik ka moja → Ditlhopho → Tše di godimo → tloša letshwao go "Gatelela" le/goba "Khupa". Morago o kitla o dira SHREDDER gape.
